item.title: StupidMirror 0.8.1
item.description:
• Google and GitHub sign-in now opens as a tab in your own browser, where you may already be signed in, instead of a separate sign-in window. 0.8.0 quit as soon as that window reported back. The account row shows a Cancel button while it waits.
  • Install and Relaunch no longer leaves the app stuck. Quitting waits at most four seconds for devices, recordings and agents to close, then stops what is left and exits.
